description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DecryptionTraitV2' for handling decryption operations in AWS SDK, including methods for decrypting data streams, validating options, and managing cipher streams.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of cipher text using provided provider, envelope, and options, returning a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from a cipher text stream based on tag length.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Returns a stream with the cipher text minus the authentication tag.

methods.name: validateOptionsAndEnvelope
methods.description: Validates cipher options and envelope metadata for decryption compatibility.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream based on cipher options and content encryption key.
